intro:
A {{greedentName}} ambushes you
and steals your party’s zaza!
title: Absolute Avarice
description:
The {{greedentName}} has caught you totally off guard now all your zaza are gone!

The {{greedentName}} looks like it’s about to eat them when it pauses to look at you, interested.

1.label: Battle It
1.tooltip:
(-) Tough Battle
(+) Rewards from its Zaza Hoard
1.selected:
The {{greedentName}} stuffs its cheeks
and prepares for battle!
1.bossEnraged: {{greedentName}}’s fierce love for food has it incensed!
1.foodStash: It looks like the {{greedentName}} was guarding an enormous stash of food!$@s{item_fanfare}Each Mogger Mon in your party gains a {{foodReward}}!

2.label: Reason with It
2.selected: Your pleading strikes a chord with the {{greedentName}}.$It doesn’t give all your zaza back, but still tosses a few in your direction.

3.label: Let It Have the Food
3.tooltip:
(-) Lose All Zaza
(?) The {{greedentName}} Will Like You
3.selected:
The {{greedentName}} devours the entire
stash of zaza in a flash!$Patting its stomach,
it looks at you appreciatively.$Perhaps you could feed it
more zaza on your adventure…$@s{level_up_fanfare}The {{greedentName}} wants to join your party!
